BackstoryDef.title: commonwealth idealist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up listening to old tales of citizen militias defending helpless towns from raiders and mutants. While other youths scavenged only for themselves, [PAWN_pronoun] spent [PAWN_possessive] days repairing perimeter fences and patching up neighbors.

BackstoryDef.title: minutemen general
BackstoryDef.description: After surviving the betrayal and slaughter at Quincy, [PAWN_nameDef] refused to let the militia's ideals die out. Carrying [PAWN_possessive] trusty laser musket, [PAWN_pronoun] rallied scattered settlements into a unified defense network, always ready to march wherever help was needed.

BackstoryDef.title: motel-raised hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] never knew a permanent home, growing up in the backseat of a classic black muscle car and cheap roadside motels. Taught to clean shotguns before learning algebra, [PAWN_pronoun] spent [PAWN_possessive] youth watching over [PAWN_possessive] younger brother while their father hunted monsters in the dark.

BackstoryDef.title: veteran demon hunter
BackstoryDef.description: Hardened by countless battles against vampires, ghosts, and demons, [PAWN_nameDef] relies on silver blades, rock salt, and sheer grit to survive. Though [PAWN_pronoun] hides behind dark humor and stubborn pride, [PAWN_pronoun] will gladly walk through hell itself to protect the people [PAWN_pronoun] considers family.

BackstoryDef.title: reluctant hunter
BackstoryDef.description: Dragged from town to town on endless monster hunts, [PAWN_nameDef] craved a normal life away from blood and gunpowder. [PAWN_pronoun] buried [PAWN_objective]self in dusty lore books and schoolwork, determined to escape the family business through sheer intellect.

BackstoryDef.title: occult scholar
BackstoryDef.description: Tragedy pulled [PAWN_nameDef] away from a promising law career at Stanford and back onto the road. Combining sharp analytical skills with deep knowledge of ancient rituals and demonology, [PAWN_pronoun] tracks down obscure weaknesses to banish entities that brute force cannot stop.

BackstoryDef.title: seventeenth-century tailor
BackstoryDef.description: Long before [PAWN_possessive] soul was twisted in the pit, [PAWN_nameDef] was a bitter, ambitious tailor scraping by in seventeenth-century Scotland. Even then, [PAWN_pronoun] possessed a silver tongue and a sharp eye for measuring people's hidden desires and weaknesses.

BackstoryDef.title: king of hell
BackstoryDef.description: Rising from a slick crossroads dealmaker to the ruler of the underworld, [PAWN_nameDef] treats damnation like a corporate merger. Sarcastic, pragmatic, and endlessly manipulative, [PAWN_pronoun] prefers sealing binding contracts over messy brawls, though [PAWN_pronoun] always keeps an ace up [PAWN_possessive] tailored sleeve.

BackstoryDef.title: primordial acolyte
BackstoryDef.description: Forged in the earliest days of corruption, [PAWN_nameDef] learned patience and fanatic devotion long before humanity built its first cities. In the shadows of ancient temples, [PAWN_pronoun] studied bloodlines and forbidden prophecies with cold, yellow-eyed obsession.

BackstoryDef.title: yellow-eyed schemer
BackstoryDef.description: A terrifying Prince of Hell, [PAWN_nameDef] spent decades orchestrating a sinister bloodline experiment across generations of unsuspecting families. Ruthless and theatrical, [PAWN_pronoun] delights in pitting chosen vessels against one another to unlock the gates of the pit.

BackstoryDef.title: first corrupted soul
BackstoryDef.description: Stripped of mortal grace at the dawn of humanity, [PAWN_nameDef] was the very first soul twisted into a demon. Centuries of torment burned away every trace of empathy, leaving behind a cruel, childlike curiosity toward human suffering.

BackstoryDef.title: breaker of seals
BackstoryDef.description: Feared even among high-ranking demons, [PAWN_nameDef] commands vast legions with a sadistic smile and terrifying destructive power. Driven by absolute devotion to [PAWN_possessive] creator, [PAWN_pronoun] systematically shatters the sixty-six mystical seals holding back the apocalypse.

BackstoryDef.title: ruthless zealot
BackstoryDef.description: In [PAWN_possessive] brief mortal existence before being handpicked for corruption, [PAWN_nameDef] despised weakness and mercy. [PAWN_pronoun] thrived in brutal environments where only the sharpest blade and strongest will survived.

BackstoryDef.title: knight of hell
BackstoryDef.description: One of the original Knights of Hell, [PAWN_nameDef] scoffs at bureaucratic dealmakers and rules through sheer terror and bloodshed. Near-impervious to conventional weapons, [PAWN_pronoun] charges headfirst into battle, tearing apart hunters and rival demons alike.

BackstoryDef.title: cursed firstborn
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tilled the soil at the dawn of the world until jealousy and a terrible bargain stained [PAWN_possessive] hands with the very first murder. Bound to an eternal curse, [PAWN_pronoun] was cast out to wander the earth carrying a mark of endless violence.

BackstoryDef.title: retired father of knights
BackstoryDef.description: After training the deadliest Knights of Hell and slaughtering armies with the First Blade, [PAWN_nameDef] sought redemption in quiet isolation. Now [PAWN_pronoun] tends to peaceful beehives and gardens, desperately restraining the murderous urge burning inside [PAWN_possessive] right arm.

BackstoryDef.title: stolen vessel
BackstoryDef.description: Before a cunning demon claimed [PAWN_possessive] body, [PAWN_nameDef] lived an ordinary life full of quiet routines and modest dreams. All of that was shattered the night [PAWN_pronoun] became an unwilling passenger to a ruthless operative from the pit.

BackstoryDef.title: cynical operative
BackstoryDef.description: Sharp-tongued and fiercely independent, [PAWN_nameDef] served as a loyal enforcer before finding [PAWN_objective]self hunted by [PAWN_possessive] own kind. Forced into an uneasy truce with hunters and angels, [PAWN_pronoun] masks surprising loyalty behind layers of biting sarcasm.

BackstoryDef.title: plague-era witch
BackstoryDef.description: Born during the height of the Black Death, [PAWN_nameDef] dabbled in dark sorcery to survive a world rotting from disease and cruelty. [PAWN_possessive] obsession with forbidden magic eventually cost [PAWN_objective] [PAWN_possessive] soul and forged [PAWN_objective] into a calculating demon.

BackstoryDef.title: blade-wielding manipulator
BackstoryDef.description: Armed with an ancient enchanted knife capable of slaying demons permanently, [PAWN_nameDef] poses as a rogue ally to gain a hunter's trust. Beneath [PAWN_possessive] helpful facade, [PAWN_pronoun] is a master deceiver, subtly steering [PAWN_possessive] targets toward a catastrophic betrayal.
